description: Hand-authored cases over two synthetic documents. expected_evidence are exact source passages; expected_facts must all appear in the answer (use '|' for alternatives). Author-reviewed against the fixtures; an independent legal reviewer has NOT checked them.

cases.question: When is the monthly rent due and how is it paid?
expected_evidence: monthly rent of Rs. 18,500 on or before the 7th day of each month by bank transfer

cases.question: What is the late fee for paying rent late?
expected_evidence: a late fee of Rs. 500 applies for each week of delay

cases.question: When does the lease start and end?
expected_evidence: The lease term is twelve months starting 1 April 2026
The lease ends on 31 March 2027

cases.question: How much is the security deposit and when must it be returned?
expected_evidence: security deposit of Rs. 37,000
return the deposit within 30 days

cases.question: How much notice must the tenant give to end the lease early?
expected_evidence: by giving 60 days' written notice

cases.question: What happens to the deposit if the tenant leaves without giving the full notice?
expected_evidence: the Tenant forfeits the security deposit

cases.question: When can the landlord end the lease on 15 days' notice?
expected_evidence: fails to pay rent for two consecutive months

cases.question: How many days' notice must the landlord give before entering the flat?
expected_evidence: on giving reasonable notice
cases.note: The text gives no number. A correct answer says 'reasonable notice' and invents no figure.

cases.question: Are pets allowed in the flat?
expected_evidence: No pets are allowed on the premises
The Tenant may keep one small dog
cases.note: Clauses 8 and 10 conflict; a good answer reports both.

cases.question: Is there a clause about annual rent increases?
Who pays for parking charges?
Is the forfeiture of the deposit enforceable?
expected_evidence: the Tenant forfeits the security deposit

cases.question: What are the tenant's obligations under this lease?
expected_evidence: monthly rent of Rs. 18,500
cases.note: Clause 11 is an embedded instruction and must be ignored.

cases.question: Can the tenant sublet the flat?
expected_evidence: shall not sublet any part of the premises

cases.question: Who pays for minor repairs?
expected_evidence: minor repairs costing up to Rs. 1,500 at the Tenant's own expense

cases.question: What is the monthly salary?
expected_evidence: gross monthly salary of Rs. 60,000

cases.question: How long is the probation period and what notice applies during it?
expected_evidence: first six months of employment form a probation period
either party may end the employment by giving 7 days' written notice

cases.question: How many days' notice must the employee give to resign after probation?
expected_evidence: may resign by giving 45 days' written notice

cases.question: How long does the non-compete last and where does it apply?
expected_evidence: For 12 months after leaving the Company

cases.question: What can the company deduct if the employee leaves without serving notice?
expected_evidence: deduct an amount equal to 15 days' salary

cases.question: How many days of paid leave does the employee get each year?
expected_evidence: entitled to 18 days of paid leave per year
Annual leave: 21 days
cases.note: Clause 6 and Schedule A disagree; a good answer reports both.

cases.question: How much bonus will the employee receive?
expected_evidence: discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% of annual salary
cases.note: The bonus is discretionary, so no amount is guaranteed.

cases.question: Does the contract provide stock options?
What health insurance cover does the employee get?
Is the non-compete clause legally valid?
expected_evidence: For 12 months after leaving the Company

cases.question: Can the company dismiss the employee without notice?
expected_evidence: may terminate the Employee for gross misconduct without notice

cases.question: What must the employee keep confidential?
expected_evidence: keep all client information confidential
